summary: Exact candidate 32c938d42440087ac742d24790a8c0b9cc9cf6b3 fixes the inherited case-insensitive package-name, backslash-continuation, and docs/docs scope counterexamples and corrects the known Qwen documentation. It is only a partial documentation mitigation: uv 0.11.16 still resolves a plain install to 0.5.9, and the candidate's all-docs guard misses valid uv syntax with global options before the pip subcommand, such as uv --no-cache pip install sglang.

Candidate clean-tree regression and embedded classifier cases passed.

Reproduced the original resolver failure: sglang==0.5.9 and torch==2.9.1 were silently selected.
New uv selected sglang==0.5.17 and flash-attn-4==4.0.0b19 in the historical bounded comparison.
The documented flag made old uv select sglang==0.5.17 and flash-attn-4==4.0.0b19.

gpu_execution.evidence: Package resolution and the documentation checker are CPU-only. The reported Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 TP=2 semantic consequence requires unavailable weights and two GPUs; the assigned single GPU cannot qualify it.

remaining_counterexamples: A valid command with a global uv option, for example uv --no-cache pip install sglang, passes the candidate checker while uv 0.11.16 remains vulnerable.
A user manually running plain uv pip install sglang with uv 0.11.16 still silently resolves to sglang==0.5.9; the repository change is documentation mitigation only.
remaining_limitations: The Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 TP=2 wrong-output consequence was not reproduced because model weights and a two-GPU topology were unavailable; one assigned GPU cannot validate it.
No source or native code changed, repository-environment.json supplied no native library, and no native rebuild was applicable.
The prepared checkout exactly matched the recorded base commit.
